Final build and both evals again, plus a diff check that only intended files changed.
Clean (results dir is ignored; help-a11y probe fully removed). Committing source and the rebuilt dist separately, matching the repo's habit of committing dist.

The sidebar and chat panel can now be collapsed and resized on wide screens, and both required evals pass. One existing suite, `help-a11y`, fails 1–2 checks, but those failures are still there with my layout changes switched off. It's committed on `reqforge/TASK-0056` in two commits: `71867d9` (source, suites, help) and `caf3f05` (rebuilt `web/dist`, which the repo tracks).

**What changed**
- **Widths:** `web/src/App.tsx` no longer has fixed 270/410 px columns. The widths come from a new `web/src/state/panels.tsx` and are saved in the browser under one key, `reqforge.panels`, through `src/lib/storage.ts`. The key isn't tied to a project, so the layout survives both reloads and project switches. Whether the chat is open was already stored under `reqforge.chat.open`.
- **Limits:** if the window is too narrow, the chat shrinks first, then the sidebar, so the main area never drops below 480 px. Your chosen widths come back when the window is wide again.
- **Resize handles** (new `web/src/components/PanelHandle.tsx`): one on each panel's inner edge, announced as a separator with its current, minimum and maximum width. You can drag them or use the arrow keys (16 px a step). Enter collapses the panel and double-click restores the default width. I also added Home/End to jump to the minimum/maximum, which the task didn't ask for.
- **Sidebar:** has a collapse button. Collapsed, it leaves a 40 px rail with an expand button, and keyboard focus moves sensibly between the two.
- **Chat:** the existing × is now the collapse control. Closing it moves focus to the header's Chat button, which reopens it and now reports whether the chat is open.
- **Narrow screens:** the handles and rail are hidden, so the slide-out sidebar and full-screen chat work as before.
- **Tests and help:** new suites `web/e2e/suites/panels.js` and `panels-a11y.js` are registered in `web/e2e/run.mjs`, tagged with REQ-0064#AC1–AC5. I added arrow, Home and End keys to the key helper in `e2e/lib/prelude.js`. The help guide `web/help/01-browse-and-filter.md` has a new section, "Make room: collapse or resize the side panels".

**Tests run**
- Type-check, lint (`oxlint`) and `npm run build` all pass.
- E1: `node web/e2e/run.mjs --junit web/e2e/results/junit-panels.xml --suite panels` passed, 48/48.
- E2: `node web/e2e/run.mjs --junit web/e2e/results/junit-panels-a11y.xml --suite panels-a11y` passed, 29/29.
- Existing suites: `core` 42/42, `help` 31/31, `projects` 70/70, `next-action` 42/42 and `theme` 16/16 all pass.
- `help-a11y` fails every time on "chat help opens the panel with focus inside", and sometimes also on "next Esc closes the record drawer". After Esc closes the help panel over the record drawer, every simulated key press stalls for its full 5 s timeout. I rebuilt with the original layout, original header attributes and without the new guide section, and it still failed the same way. So it isn't this change, but I couldn't confirm it against a clean build of main.

**Left open**
- The `help-a11y` failure above needs looking into separately.
- The reqforge server tools failed to connect (the `bin/reqforge` binary is missing), so I didn't run the trace or verify commands.

NEXT: Run `node web/e2e/run.mjs --suite help-a11y` on a clean main checkout to confirm the CDP stall after Esc closes the record drawer predates TASK-0056, then review branch reqforge/TASK-0056.
